{"metadata":{"description":"Codex-style /btw command for DeepSeek Harness: side questions answered in a conversation-seeded subagent context, without polluting the main context","id":"gh:1345083267","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-btw-plugin","slug":"JasonQQ/dsh-btw-plugin","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Codex-style /btw command for DeepSeek Harness: side questions answered in a conversation-seeded suba"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"gent context, without polluting the main context"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @jasonqq/dsh-btw-plugin"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A Codex-style `/btw` command for DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`/btw <question>` answers a side question **in a sub-context seeded with the main
conversation**, an"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"d shows the answer in the chat **without ever adding it to the
main conversation's model history**. "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"Ask "by the way…" questions freely — the
main context stays clean."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- The command is registered through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands` (the same
registry that powers `/com"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"pact`, `/goal`, `/plan`).
- The question is delegated through `ctx.subagents.start("fork", …)`. The
"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"`fork` provider spawns a child agent **seeded with the parent's completed
turns**, so the side quest"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ion is answered with full knowledge of the main
conversation.
- The child's answer is returned as a "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"plain command result. Command results are
rendered by the UI adapter and **never enter the model his"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"tory** — that is the
"no pollution" guarantee."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"In any session composer:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The answer appears as a command result card. It does not become a message the
